capabilities.description: Allow approved apps and the assistant to drive the running Calculator UI: list its views, navigate between them, open the history panel, and read the calculation history as structured data. These scopes only change what is displayed or read saved data; they never modify calculations.
capabilities.name: Drive the Calculator UI

scopes.description: List every navigable view in the Calculator UI. Returns { views: [{ id, name, description, params? }] } explaining what each view shows and which entityId/params it accepts. Call this before calculator.ui.navigate when unsure which view id to target.
scopes.name: Describe UI views

scopes.description: Navigate the open Calculator UI to a view; the running client applies the change visibly and nothing is modified. view is a view id from calculator.ui.describe: "calc" (the keypad), "convert" (unit/currency conversion), or "history" (the past-calculations panel). Optional entityId is a history entry id (from calculator.ui.read or calculator.history.recent); with view "calc" it loads that past calculation into the keypad. params carries view-specific options: { expression } for "calc", { category } for "convert", { query } for "history". Returns { ok: true, intentId }.

entityId.description: Optional history entry id (from calculator.ui.read or calculator.history.recent). With view "calc", loads that entry into the keypad.

params.description: View-specific options: { expression: string } for "calc" (prefill the keypad), { category: string } for "convert" (one of length, mass, temperature, volume, area, speed, data, time, currency), { query: string } for "history" (prefill the history search box).

scopes.name: Navigate the UI

scopes.description: Read the content behind the Calculator UI as structured JSON. Without parameters, returns every saved calculation and conversion newest first. With entityId, returns one history entry. With query, filters history by expression or result. view optionally labels or shapes the calc, convert, or history projection. Read-only.

entityId.description: Optional history entry id to read on its own.

query.description: Optional expression or result substring used to filter history.

view.description: Optional view id (calc, convert, or history) to label the response with.

scopes.name: Read the history

scopes.description: Open the History panel in the running Calculator UI so the user can see their past calculations and conversions. Takes no parameters. Purely visual navigation; nothing is modified. Returns { ok: true, intentId }.
scopes.name: Show the history panel
